grammar_title: 过去完成时(had done;与一般过去时的先后关系)
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第一册 Unit 5 Using language:过去完成时(had done)。句子地道、自然/科学/发现主题;干扰项为一般过去时/现在完成时/一般现在时,使过去完成时为唯一正确形式。

points.point: had done:在某个过去时间点之前 / 在另一个过去动作之前已完成
points.overview: 句中有 by/before/when/by the time 等过去参照点,某动作在该参照点之前已经发生、完成,用过去完成时 had done;主句或参照为一般过去时。

points.point: 过去完成时 vs 一般过去时:先发生的动作用 had done
points.overview: 一句话里有两个过去动作,先发生的(更早的)用过去完成时 had done,后发生的用一般过去时;通过先后顺序判断哪一个用过去完成时。

points.point: 间接引语中的过去完成时 & no sooner…than / hardly…when 倒装
points.overview: 间接引语里,比'说'更早发生的过去动作要回退为过去完成时;no sooner…than、hardly…when 句首倒装时,助动词用 had(had + 主语 + 过去分词)。

questions.stem: By the time the Beagle reached the islands, Darwin ____ many samples of plants and animals.
questions.explanation: by the time + 过去,采集动作在到达之前就已完成 → 过去完成时 had collected。

questions.stem: Before he left England, Darwin ____ medical school without finishing his degree.
questions.explanation: before 引出的过去参照点之前已发生的动作用过去完成时 had left。

questions.stem: When the storm finally stopped, the ship ____ already sailed far from the coast.
questions.explanation: already sailed 表示在 stopped 之前就完成,助动词用 had。

questions.stem: By 1835, the birds ____ into several clearly different species.
questions.explanation: by + 过去年份,之前已完成的进化用过去完成时 had evolved。

questions.stem: Darwin realised that the finches ____ from a common ancestor long before.
questions.explanation: long before 表示比 realised 更早,用过去完成时 had come。

questions.stem: Before the goats arrived, the tortoises ____ the plants that grew naturally there.
questions.explanation: before 过去参照点之前的动作用过去完成时 had eaten。

questions.stem: By the end of the voyage, his small cabin ____ full of samples.
questions.explanation: by the end of + 过去,之前已完成的变化用过去完成时 had become。

questions.stem: When she checked the pot, a tiny green stem ____ already appeared.
questions.explanation: already appeared 表示在 checked 之前已出现,助动词用 had。

questions.stem: Darwin noticed that some species ____ very little since ancient times.
questions.explanation: noticed 为过去,从句中更早的情况用过去完成时 had changed。

questions.stem: By the time scientists studied the water bear, it ____ already survived extreme cold.
questions.explanation: by the time + 过去,already survived 之前已完成,助动词用 had。

questions.stem: Before Mendel died in 1884, he ____ important discoveries about genetics.
questions.explanation: before + 过去时间,之前完成的动作用过去完成时 had made。

questions.stem: When the wasps arrived, the bean plant ____ already released its warning chemicals.
questions.explanation: already released 表示在 arrived 之前完成,助动词用 had。

questions.stem: Darwin saw species on the islands that ____ never been recorded before.
questions.explanation: never been recorded before 表示在 saw 之前的情况,用过去完成时,助动词 had。

questions.stem: Before the journal entry was written, each bulb ____ produced a single flower.
questions.explanation: before + 过去,之前已完成的动作用过去完成时,助动词 had。

questions.stem: By the time the keeper arrived, George ____ already become famous worldwide.
questions.explanation: by the time + 过去,already become 之前完成,助动词用 had。

questions.stem: After the seeds ____ been planted, water was added to the soil.
questions.explanation: after 引出更早的动作,被动的过去完成时用 had been planted,助动词 had。

questions.stem: Darwin explained that the beaks ____ to match the food on each island.
questions.explanation: explained 为过去,从句中更早的进化用过去完成时 had adapted。

questions.stem: By 1859, Darwin ____ his whole theory in a famous book.
questions.explanation: by + 过去年份,之前已完成的动作用过去完成时 had explained。

questions.stem: When the researchers reached the forest, the fungi ____ already linked the trees underground.
questions.explanation: already linked 表示在 reached 之前完成,助动词用 had。

questions.stem: Before the book was published, many people ____ never questioned the old ideas about species.
questions.explanation: never questioned before 表示在 published 之前的情况,用过去完成时,助动词 had。

questions.stem: After Darwin ____ some time in South America, he sailed on to the Galápagos.
questions.explanation: 两个过去动作中,逗留先发生,用过去完成时 had spent;后面 sailed 用一般过去时。

questions.stem: The finches had evolved from an ancestor that ____ on the islands long before.
questions.explanation: 到达比进化更早,先发生的动作用过去完成时 had arrived。

questions.stem: Once the insects ____ the leaves, the plant began to release chemicals.
questions.explanation: 攻击先发生、随后才释放化学物质,先发生的用过去完成时 had attacked。

questions.stem: Darwin carefully studied the samples that he ____ during the long voyage.
questions.explanation: 采集在研究之前,先发生的动作用过去完成时 had collected。

questions.stem: The tortoise population fell sharply because goats ____ almost all its food.
questions.explanation: 山羊吃光食物在数量下降之前,先发生的用过去完成时 had eaten。

questions.stem: People were shocked because they ____ always believed that species never changed.
questions.explanation: 震惊之前一直持有的旧观念用过去完成时 had always believed,助动词 had。

questions.stem: When the wasps came, the harmful insects ____ already damaged much of the crop.
questions.explanation: 破坏庄稼在黄蜂到来之前完成,先发生的用过去完成时,助动词 had。

questions.stem: Mendel chose pea plants because earlier work ____ him their traits were easy to control.
questions.explanation: 先前的研究在他选择之前已让他明白,用过去完成时 had taught。

questions.stem: By the time George was found, all the other Pinta tortoises ____ already died.
questions.explanation: 其他陆龟死亡在乔治被发现之前,先发生的用过去完成时,助动词 had。

questions.stem: The young plant grew tall and strong because someone ____ it carefully every day.
questions.explanation: 之前每天浇水促成了后来的生长,先发生的用过去完成时 had watered。

questions.stem: Darwin often asked himself how the different species ____ come to exist at all.
questions.explanation: 物种出现远早于他发问,先发生的用过去完成时,助动词 had。

questions.stem: She drew the flower exactly as it ____ looked the week before.
questions.explanation: the week before 表示画之前的样子,用过去完成时,助动词 had。

questions.stem: The forest recovered quickly because the fungi ____ the trees together underground.
questions.explanation: 真菌连接在森林恢复之前已完成,先发生的用过去完成时 had linked。

questions.stem: After the bulbs ____ been planted, the container was put in a dark place.
questions.explanation: 种球先被种下、后放进暗处,先发生的被动动作用过去完成时,助动词 had。

questions.stem: The chilli plant reacted at once because it ____ a warning from its neighbour.
questions.explanation: 察觉警告在反应之前,先发生的用过去完成时 had detected。

questions.stem: Many readers refused to accept the idea, although Darwin ____ explained it very clearly.
questions.explanation: 达尔文解释在读者拒绝之前已完成,先发生的用过去完成时,助动词 had。

questions.stem: By the time the ship returned home, Darwin ____ enough evidence for his theory.
questions.explanation: 搜集证据在返航之前完成,先发生的用过去完成时 had gathered。

questions.stem: The keeper said the tortoise looked much weaker than it ____ the year before.
questions.explanation: the year before 指更早的状态,用过去完成时,助动词 had。

questions.stem: The new species appeared only after older forms slowly ____ over millions of years.
questions.explanation: 旧形态的变化在新物种出现之前,先发生的用过去完成时 had changed。

questions.stem: Scientists named the strange creature only after they ____ it in the wild.
questions.explanation: 发现在命名之前,先发生的用过去完成时 had found。

questions.stem: Darwin said that he ____ the finches carefully before he understood their meaning.
questions.explanation: 间接引语里比'说'更早的动作回退为过去完成时 had studied。

questions.stem: The keeper explained that George ____ the last of his kind for many years.
questions.explanation: explained 为过去,更早且延续的情况回退为过去完成时 had been。

questions.stem: Scientists reported that the species ____ from a single common ancestor.
questions.explanation: 间接引语里更早完成的进化回退为过去完成时 had evolved。

questions.stem: Darwin wrote that the birds' beaks ____ to suit the food on each island.
questions.explanation: wrote 为过去,更早的动作回退为过去完成时 had adapted。

questions.stem: She told us that the seeds ____ already sprouted by the third week.
questions.explanation: told 为过去,already sprouted 更早完成,回退为过去完成时,助动词 had。

questions.stem: He realised that the goats ____ destroyed the tortoise's main food supply.
questions.explanation: realised 之前山羊已破坏食物,回退为过去完成时,助动词 had。

questions.stem: The guide said that plants ____ each other through chemicals long before scientists noticed.
questions.explanation: long before 表更早,间接引语回退为过去完成时 had warned。

questions.stem: Darwin admitted that he ____ medical school without ever finishing his degree.
questions.explanation: admitted 之前发生的离校,回退为过去完成时 had left。

questions.stem: The report stated that the fungi ____ the whole forest together underground.
questions.explanation: stated 为过去,更早完成的连接回退为过去完成时 had linked。

questions.stem: Mendel noted that the pea plants ____ him a great deal about genetics.
questions.explanation: noted 之前豌豆实验已给出启示,回退为过去完成时 had taught。

questions.stem: No sooner ____ the ship reached the islands than Darwin noticed the strange birds.
questions.explanation: No sooner 句首倒装,助动词用 had:No sooner had + 主语 + 过去分词。

questions.stem: Hardly ____ the insects attacked the plant when it began to release chemicals.
questions.explanation: Hardly…when 句首倒装,助动词用 had:Hardly had + 主语 + 过去分词。

questions.stem: No sooner ____ the goats arrived than the tortoise population started to fall.
questions.explanation: No sooner…than 句首倒装,助动词用 had。

questions.stem: Hardly ____ Darwin opened the box when even more samples fell out.
questions.explanation: Hardly…when 句首倒装,助动词用 had。

questions.stem: No sooner ____ the seed been planted than the gardener added water to the soil.
questions.explanation: No sooner 句首倒装,被动用 had been planted,助动词 had。

questions.stem: Hardly ____ the team landed on the island when they began collecting plants.
questions.explanation: Hardly…when 句首倒装,助动词用 had。

questions.stem: No sooner ____ the book been published than it caused a storm of argument.
questions.explanation: No sooner 句首倒装,被动用 had been published,助动词 had。

questions.stem: Hardly ____ the sun risen when the birds started singing across the forest.
questions.explanation: Hardly…when 句首倒装,助动词用 had。

questions.stem: No sooner ____ scientists found one new species than they discovered another.
questions.explanation: No sooner…than 句首倒装,助动词用 had。

questions.stem: Hardly ____ the chilli plant sensed danger when it changed its behaviour.
questions.explanation: Hardly…when 句首倒装,助动词用 had。
